# Daily AI Newsletter Digest - 16/1/2026

## 🔥 Top Stories
- Apple partners with Google to use Gemini models in an upgraded version of Siri, replacing ChatGPT as the main AI layer, in a multi-year deal that deepens their partnership and reshapes Apple's AI approach.
- OpenAI and Anthropic are reportedly working on potential public offerings, with estimated valuations of $500 billion and $350 billion, respectively, joining SpaceX in a historic IPO wave.
- Google has launched Personal Intelligence for Gemini, a feature that connects Gemini to users' accounts to deliver personalized answers, available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers but turned off by default.

## 🤖 AI Models & Research
- **Gemini's Personal Intelligence**: Connects Gemini to users' Gmail, Photos, YouTube, and Search to deliver answers tailored to their life, with a focus on user privacy and control.
- **OpenAI and Cerebras Deal**: A $10 billion deal to receive 750 megawatts of compute through 2028, aiming to boost inference speed for OpenAI's products.
- **Character.ai Inference Speed**: Achieved a 2x production inference performance increase through GPU workload tuning and hardware-level optimizations.
- Researchers from Mongolian National University of Education introduced a motion-capture processing engine that treats the human body as a structured, connected system evolving over time, showing improved performance in handling occlusion, rapid motion, and preserving subtle motion detail.

## 🛠️ Tools & Products
- **Apple Creator Studio**: A new subscription service that groups Apple's professional creative apps into one package, including Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, and Apple's productivity apps, with new intelligent features designed to save time and simplify creative workflows.
- **Notion Agents**: A collection of 100 outcome-oriented prompts for Notion Agents, including "Agent Steps" that show exactly how an Agent will execute and what it will produce.
- **Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)**: An open standard for AI agents developed by Shopify and Google, defining the discovery and negotiation mechanisms between agent and merchant.
- **GPT-5.2-Codex**: An upgraded version of GPT-5.2 optimized for agentic coding tasks, supporting four levels of reasoning effort settings and a 400,000-token context window.
- **Ministral 3**: A new family of dense language models optimized for low-resource environments, offering base, instruction-tuned, and reasoning variants.

## 📰 Industry News
- **Airbnb's New CTO**: Ahmad Al-Dahle, former head of GenAI at Meta, joins Airbnb to enhance AI in travel and e-commerce, leading the development of an AI-powered travel concierge.
- **Meta Layoffs**: Cutting around 10% of its Reality Labs division, shutting down multiple VR game studios, and scaling back metaverse investments.
- **Tesla's Full Self-Driving Software**: Moving to a monthly subscription model, starting at $99, replacing the previous one-time payment of $8,000.
- SpaceX plans to attempt a mission to Mars by the end of 2026, coinciding with a rare planetary alignment, with several core technologies still in development.

## 📚 Resources & Learning
- **Prompt Engineering**: A new paper from Google Research suggests that repeating a prompt can improve the accuracy of AI models, with a "prompt repetition" strategy winning 47 out of 70 benchmark tests with zero losses.
- **Claude Cowork**: A step-by-step guide on how to use Claude Cowork to perform non-technical tasks, including selecting a folder, telling Claude what to do, and editing files directly.
- **AI Learning Resources**: Various courses and tutorials, including ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers, Applied Machine Learning in Python, Meta Android Developer Professional Certificate, Python Data Fundamentals, and AI Fundamentals.

## Uncovering AI Newsletter

### Key Highlights
- Lenovo introduces Kira, a modular AI assistant that works across devices.
- OpenAI launches ChatGPT Health, a new feature to consolidate and analyze medical data.
- Gmail enters the Gemini era with AI-powered features for productivity.
- Meta's smart glasses now feature a "handwriting" mode and teleprompter.

### Detailed Points
- **Lenovo Kira**: A modular AI assistant that uses both local on-device models and cloud-based models, allowing for seamless syncing across devices, including Motorola phones and Lenovo laptops. Kira's features include cross-device sync, modular brain, and picking the "best model at the time" for tasks.
- **ChatGPT Health**: OpenAI's new feature that consolidates medical data from various sources, including Apple Health, Function, and My Fitness Pal, and provides actionable insights. It also helps prepare for appointments and understands recent test results. The data is kept in a secure, separate section to protect privacy.
- **Gmail Gemini**: Gmail's new AI-powered features aim to increase productivity, including summarizing long email threads and suggesting responses. The "Summarize this email" chip and "Help me write" feature are key components of Gmail Gemini.
- **Meta's Smart Glasses**: Recently announced features include a "handwriting" mode and a built-in teleprompter for creators. However, Meta is pausing international expansion of its glasses due to high demand.
- **Other Developments**: Google TV gets a Gemini upgrade, and LTX2, a fully open-source video generation model, has been released.

## TAAFT - There's An AI For That

### Key Highlights
- AI drone rescue technology successfully located a missing person that 50 rescuers missed.
- Google's new "Personal Intelligence" feature connects Gemini to users' Gmail, Photos, Search, and YouTube history for tailored AI responses.
- Cerebras partners with OpenAI to enhance AI response speed.
- The FTC sues an "AI search engine" for using dark patterns.

### Detailed Points
- **Gemini Gets Personal**: Google's new feature connects Gemini to users' personal data, such as Gmail, Photos, Search, and YouTube history, to provide AI responses tailored specifically to them.
- **Faster ChatGPT Is Coming**: Cerebras partners with OpenAI to add 750MW of low-latency power to OpenAI's compute stack, enhancing the speed of AI responses.
- **US Greenlights Nvidia China Sales**: The US approves Nvidia's H200 chips for export to China, with conditions including a 25% fee on sales and restrictions on military use.
- **AI Drone Footage Solved a Missing Person Case**: An AI analyzed drone footage and successfully located a missing person that 50 rescuers were unable to find.
- **FTC Sues an "AI Search Engine"**: The FTC sues JustAnswer's "AI search engine" Pearl for using dark patterns, including a subscription trap.
- **Openwork**: An open-source AI agent that runs locally on a computer, using SearxNG and local LLMs or cloud providers for cited answers without tracking searches.
- **Medeo**: A video editing tool that allows users to describe what they want in a chat, and the AI builds the video in real-time.

## World of AI Newsletter

### Key Highlights
- Google has introduced a new feature called "Personal Intelligence" for its AI assistant Gemini, allowing it to connect with users' Google apps and data to provide more personalized answers.
- This update enables Gemini to understand users' context better, making it more relevant and integrated into daily life.
- The feature is opt-in, and users can choose which apps to connect and disconnect data at any time.

### Detailed Points
- Gemini's Personal Intelligence feature allows it to connect with various Google apps and services, including Gmail, Google Photos, search history, YouTube activity, and calendar.
- This enables Gemini to provide more contextual answers, taking into account the user's history, preferences, and current activities.
- The feature is designed to make Gemini feel more like a personal assistant, understanding the user's world and providing relevant information without needing explicit context.
- Personal Intelligence is currently rolling out gradually, starting with paid tiers in some regions.
- The update is seen as a significant step towards truly personal AI, with potential applications in managing life logistics and daily tasks.
- Google has emphasized user control and privacy, with the feature being opt-in and allowing users to disconnect data at any time.
- The introduction of Personal Intelligence is part of a broader trend in AI development, moving from answering questions generically to understanding people better.
- This update has implications for the future of AI assistants, with potential advancements in contextual awareness and personalization.

## The Rundown AI

### Key Highlights
- Google's Gemini AI has launched a new feature called "Personal Intelligence" that integrates with Gmail, Photos, and YouTube to provide personalized responses.
- Matthew McConaughey has trademarked himself to fight deepfakes.
- The newsletter covers various AI tools, including Thesys, Personal Intelligence, GLM-Image, and MedGemma 1.5.
- A community workflow is featured, showcasing how a reader uses AI to manage youth basketball team substitutions.

### Detailed Points
- **Google's Gemini AI**: The company has launched a new feature called "Personal Intelligence" that allows Gemini to pull information from Gmail, Photos, and YouTube to provide personalized responses. The feature is available to Gemini AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in the US.
- **McConaughey Trademarks Himself**: Matthew McConaughey has trademarked his voice, likeness, and video clips to combat AI deepfakes and misuse.
- **AI Tools**:
  - Thesys: A tool that generates interactive UI for AI apps.
  - Personal Intelligence: A feature that personalizes Gemini with information from apps like Gmail.
  - GLM-Image: An open-source image generation model developed by Z AI.
  - MedGemma 1.5: An updated medical model developed by Google.
- **Community Workflow**: A reader shares how they use AI to manage youth basketball team substitutions, using a table to track player data and generating a substitution plan.
- **Company Updates**:
  - OpenAI has partnered with Cerebras to deploy 750MW of dedicated processing power for faster AI responses.
  - ElevenLabs is partnering with Deutsche Telekom to deploy AI voice agents for customer service.
  - Slack has updated its Slackbot to act as a personal AI agent.
  - OpenAI has made its GPT-5.2-Codex model available to developers via the Responses API.
- **Z AI**: The company has released GLM-Image, an open-source image generation model trained on Huawei chips.

## JournalClub.io Newsletter

### Key Highlights
- Researchers from Mongolian National University of Education introduced a motion-capture processing engine that treats the human body as a structured, connected system evolving over time.
- The system combines an optimized graph convolutional network (GCN) with multi-scale feature fusion to resolve traditional motion capture limitations.
- The model was evaluated on two benchmark datasets and showed improved performance in handling occlusion, rapid motion, and preserving subtle motion detail.

### Detailed Points
- The system uses a GCN to explicitly encode the topological structure of the body, allowing it to propagate information along natural pathways.
- A gating attention mechanism is introduced to adjust the importance of each joint based on the current state of each node.
- The model includes a multi-scale feature extraction module to capture global motion patterns, fine details, and mid-level patterns simultaneously.
- The system was compared to several baselines and showed lower positional error, smoother motion, and higher robustness, especially in scenarios like occlusion and rapid movement.
- Ablation tests revealed that the performance gains came from the interaction of spatial graph modeling, temporal consistency, and multi-scale feature fusion.
- The system has potential applications in animation, VR, and interactive systems.

## TLDR AI

- Gemini introduces Personal Intelligence, a beta feature that connects Google apps to personalize user experiences by securely linking Gmail, Photos, YouTube, and Search for tailored assistance.

- Airbnb appoints Ahmad Al-Dahle, former head of GenAI at Meta, as its new technology chief to enhance AI in travel and e-commerce.

### Detailed Points
- **Gemini's Personal Intelligence**: This feature prioritizes user privacy, allowing users to control app connections and enhance the AI's ability to provide specific, informed responses. It is launching in the US and connects Google apps to personalize user experiences.
- **OpenAI and Cerebras Deal**: The multi-year deal worth over $10 billion aims to boost inference speed for OpenAI's products, with Cerebras providing 750 megawatts of compute through 2028.
- **Character.ai Inference Speed**: Character.ai achieved a 2x production inference performance increase through GPU workload tuning and hardware-level optimizations, reducing latency and cost across its systems.
- **Airbnb's New Technology Chief**: Ahmad Al-Dahle, former head of GenAI at Meta, joins Airbnb to enhance AI in travel and e-commerce, marking a significant move in the company's strategic focus on tech-driven growth.
- **Notion Agents**: A collection of 100 outcome-oriented prompts for Notion Agents is available, including "Agent Steps" that show exactly how an Agent will execute and what it will produce.
- **Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)**: Shopify and Google co-developed the UCP, an open standard for AI agents that defines the discovery and negotiation mechanisms between agent and merchant.
- **GPT-5.2-Codex**: This upgraded version of GPT-5.2 is optimized for agentic coding tasks in Codex and similar environments, supporting four levels of reasoning effort settings and a 400,000-token context window.
- **Ministral 3**: A new family of dense language models (3B, 8B, and 14B) optimized for low-resource environments, offering base, instruction-tuned, and reasoning variants.
- **Microsoft and Anthropic**: Microsoft is on track to spend $500 million per year on Anthropic AI, using it to power more of its products.

## Superhuman Newsletter

### Key Highlights
- Google has launched Personal Intelligence for Gemini, a feature that connects Gemini to users' accounts to deliver personalized answers.
- OpenAI and Anthropic are reportedly working on potential public offerings, joining SpaceX in a historic IPO wave.
- Airbnb has hired Meta's former AI leader as its new Chief Technology Officer to build an AI-powered travel concierge.

### Detailed Points
- **Gemini Personal Intelligence**: Google has unveiled a beta feature that connects Gemini to users' Gmail, Photos, YouTube, and Search to deliver answers tailored to their life. This feature is available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers but is turned off by default.

- **Airbnb's New CTO**: Ahmad Al-Dahle, Meta's former AI leader, has been hired as Airbnb's new Chief Technology Officer. He will lead the development of an AI-powered travel concierge that will help users with travel search and personalized trip planning.
- **Prompting Strategy**: A new paper from Google Research suggests that repeating a prompt can improve the accuracy of AI models. This "prompt repetition" strategy has been shown to win 47 out of 70 benchmark tests with zero losses.

## Mindstream

### Key Highlights
- Apple has partnered with Google to use Gemini models in an upgraded version of Siri, replacing ChatGPT as the main AI layer.
- Apple has launched Creator Studio, a new subscription service that groups its professional creative apps into one package.
- Meta is cutting around 10% of its Reality Labs division, shutting down multiple VR game studios and scaling back metaverse investments.

### Detailed Points
- Apple's decision to use Google's Gemini models in Siri is a win for Alphabet, whose AI already supports Samsung's Galaxy AI features, and gives Google access to Apple's ecosystem of over two billion active devices.
- The agreement is a multi-year deal that deepens the companies' long-standing partnership and reshapes Apple's AI approach, with financial details not shared, though OpenAI was also in the running.
- Apple had added ChatGPT to its devices in late 2024, allowing Siri to hand off more complex questions, but this setup remains unchanged, keeping ChatGPT as an optional layer rather than Siri's default system.
- The move has drawn criticism from Elon Musk, who raised concerns about Google's growing influence across AI, Android, and Chrome, with Musk's own firm, xAI, building competing models backed by large infrastructure spending.
- Apple Creator Studio brings together tools like Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, and Apple's productivity apps, with new intelligent features designed to save time and simplify creative workflows, most of which run on-device to keep user data private.
- The service launches on January 28, priced at $12.99 per month or $129 per year, with a one-month free trial, and students and educators can subscribe at a lower price.
- Meta's decision to cut its Reality Labs division is a shift in focus toward wearables, with the company shutting down multiple VR game studios and scaling back metaverse investments.
- Other notable updates include the NHS England delivering its first "living drug" treatment for aggressive leukaemia, and Steam activity hinting at potential remakes of Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas.
